name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==SENIOR TEST ENGINEER — MANUAL TESTING==  ·  ENTERPRISE APPLICATIONS

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Manual testing engineer with **4.8 years of experience** testing enterprise applications. Executed test cases, identified defects, and ensured product quality across payment, gaming, retail, and education domains. Proven ability to **work independently** — owned test planning, execution, and reporting for web/mobile modules as Senior QA.
